data.body: [P2] Add an Electron 44 launch smoke test. The relevant CI jobs skip downloading Electron, while the desktop Jest suite only runs under Node and never launches the application. This twelve-major upgrade can therefore break startup, the preload bridge, or the `insight://` protocol while CI remains green. Add an integration job that installs the binary, builds the UI and desktop bundles, launches the app under a virtual display, and waits for a readiness marker before exiting.
